Strings.addon.title: Nearest Wars
Strings.addon.description: The nearest systems where factions are at war or in civil war (and elections, if you like), from Spansh, with who's fighting whom. Plus the exact conflicts in systems you've visited lately: sides, stakes and days won, from your own journals.
Strings.ui.radius_tip: How far to look (click to change)
Strings.ui.auto_tip: Search again automatically after each jump
Strings.ui.copy_tip: Select the name and press Ctrl+C to paste it in the galaxy map

Strings.js.press_search: Press Search to find the nearest wars around you.
